name: dev.storyos/storyos
title: StoryOS
description: Your StoryOS workspace (records, approvals and agents) for Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: STORYOS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: StoryOS personal API token (mn_pat_...), created under API tokens in StoryOS. Scoped to one workspace.

environmentVariables.name: STORYOS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the StoryOS API, for example https://app.storyos.dev for the cloud. When unset the server uses http://localhost:3001 (local development).

environmentVariables.name: STORYOS_MCP_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Set to internal to also expose the internal tool profile. Leave unset for the default tools.

environmentVariables.name: WEB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the StoryOS web app, used to build links in tool results. When unset the server uses http://localhost:3000.
